description:
Create a reusable AI agent (POST /v2/apps/:appId/agents). Works in user auth mode (the normal hosted mode) or B2B mode; app-token mode is not accepted by the backend. Each agent is a persona - name, avatar, system prompt, LLM config, plus response-gate settings (responseMode, cooldownSec) that control when it speaks in a room. For multi-agent scenarios (two or more personas conversing in one chat) create each one separately, then `ethora-agent-invite` them into the same room. See the `ethora-agents-quickstart` prompt for the end-to-end recipe. To start from a ready-made public agent instead, `ethora-agent-list { visibility: "public" }` then `ethora-agent-clone`.
Requires: a selected app (`ethora-app-select`) or an explicit `appId`. The agent belongs to your account (only you can change it) and is homed in that app; it can still be used in your other apps.

appId.description: 24-char hex appId the agent belongs to (`POST /v2/apps/:appId/agents`). Defaults to the app selected with `ethora-app-select`. Pass it when you just created an app so the agent lands there rather than in the token's own app.

botAvatarUrl.description: URL of the avatar image shown next to bot messages.

botDisplayName.description: Display name used inside the chat UI. Defaults to `name`.

categories.description: Directory categories, any of: `customer-support` (customer-facing assistants), `persona` (a character or historical figure), `entertainment` (quizzes, games, scenarios), `worker` (internal work). Used to filter `ethora-agent-list`. Replaces the agent's current set.

cooldownSec.description: Minimum seconds between this agent's replies in a given room. Damped 2x for bot-to-bot. Set 0 for quick turn-taking in multi-agent scenarios.

flowsYaml.description: Deterministic scripted conversation for this agent, as YAML. Drives the agent through a fixed sequence (opening menu, appointment request, intake questionnaire, survey) instead of leaving every turn to the model. Compiled and validated server-side on save: an invalid script is rejected with code `FLOWS_INVALID` and per-line details, and nothing is stored. A flow named `start` is reserved and fires when a conversation opens. Buttons are authored here (`buttons:` on a `say` step, or `options:` on an `ask` step). Call `fetch` with id `doc:agent-flows` for the full authoring format before writing one. Pass an empty string to clear the script.

greetingMessage.description: Optional message the agent posts when it first joins a room.

isRAG.description: Enable retrieval-augmented generation from indexed sources.

llmProvider.description: LLM provider override (e.g. 'openai'). Defaults to the app's configured provider.

name.description: Short display name. For multi-agent scenarios, prefer single-word names (e.g. 'Hannibal', 'Varro') — the @-mention matcher uses the exact display name with word-boundary matching.

prompt.description: System prompt — the agent's persona, role, style of speech, and behaviour rules. For multi-agent scenarios, instruct the agent to end every message with an @-mention of who speaks next; that's how turn-handoff works through the response gate.

ragTags.description: Optional RAG tag filter — restrict retrieval to sources matching these tags.

responseMode.description: When the agent decides to reply. 'always' = every room message; 'mentioned' = only when @-mentioned by display name or via /bot (recommended for multi-agent turn-taking); 'smart' = a mini LLM gate decides per-message; 'probability' = coin-flip per message using `responseProbability`.

responseProbability.description: If responseMode='probability', odds (0-1) of replying to each message. Damped 0.6x for bot-to-bot messages.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (auto-generated from name if omitted).

summary.description: Short bio shown in agent lists.

trigger.description: Legacy trigger field. Prefer the newer `responseMode` for new agents.

visibility.description: 'private' (only invitable inside the owning app) or 'public' (cross-app invitable).

name: ethora-agent-create
title: Create Agent
